column1: # Language tables (A5). One word per line, tab-separated: <kind><TAB><word>.
# These used to be English arrays compiled into QueryAnalysis.c, which meant a
# language was a code patch. Adding static/lang/<lang>.tsv is now enough.
#   stop     - dropped from the query terms (never sent as topical words)
#   filler   - opinion/intent words: stripped from the SERP query because some
#              engines treat them as brands, but they still trigger the
#   disc     - marks a discussion-shaped query ("is this worth it", "X vs Y")
